Cancer and Sagittarius compatibility

How Cancer (Kark) and Sagittarius (Dhanu) are traditionally said to get on, and the reasons behind it.

At a glance

Elements
Water and Fire
Modes
Cardinal (chara) and Mutable (dwiswabhava)
Ruling planets
Moon and Jupiter
Place in the zodiac
6/8 from each other
Graha Maitri (Guna Milan)
4 of 5 points
Bhakoot (Guna Milan)
0 of 7 points (Bhakoot dosha)
Sign-level view
Mixed

Cancer horoscope · Sagittarius horoscope

The elements: Water and Fire

Sagittarius is Fire and Cancer is Water, the pairing the tradition calls steam: strong attraction, and strong reactions. Sagittarius is direct where Cancer is sensitive, so the work in this pair is in how things are said, not only what.

Temperament

Cancer is a cardinal sign that likes to lead, Sagittarius a mutable sign that adapts. That usually makes decisions easy, and the tradition's caution is only that Sagittarius's flexibility should not turn into always giving way.

The ruling planets

Cancer is ruled by the Moon and Sagittarius by Jupiter. In the natural friendship of the planets, the Moon counts Jupiter as neutral, and Jupiter counts the Moon as a friend. That gives this pair 4 of 5 points in Graha Maitri. One friendly and one neutral is close to the best this koota gives.

Their place in the zodiac

Counted from Cancer, Sagittarius is the sixth sign; counted from Sagittarius, Cancer is the eighth. In Bhakoot this is a 6/8 placement. That is a Bhakoot dosha and scores 0 of 7. The tradition takes it seriously in marriage matching, and it is one of the first things an astrologer will check in the full charts, where other factors can soften it.

What each brings

Cancer is traditionally said to bring care, emotional depth and a gift for making a home to a relationship, and to need reassurance, emotional safety and closeness to family. Sagittarius is said to bring optimism, adventure, humour and frankness, and to need freedom, space to grow and shared ideals. The pair does well when each gives what the other needs, rather than what they would want themselves.

What signs can and cannot tell you

Everything on this page is the traditional sign-level view. In Guna Milan, Graha Maitri and Bhakoot are read from the two Moon signs (rashi), which need birth times, and they are only two of the eight kootas: the others come from the nakshatras. Two people of the same pair of signs can have very different charts, so a real match is judged from both full birth charts.

Frequently asked

Common questions

Are Cancer and Sagittarius compatible?

At the level of signs the traditional reading is: mixed. Their Guna Milan points from the two sign-based kootas are 4 of 5 for Graha Maitri and 0 of 7 for Bhakoot. Signs are only a starting point; a full kundli matching of both birth charts is what decides.

Should I use my sun sign or my Moon sign here?

Guna Milan uses the Moon sign (rashi), which needs your birth time. The element and temperament notes are often read for the sun sign too, but the Graha Maitri and Bhakoot points only apply to the Moon signs.

Does it matter which partner is Cancer and which is Sagittarius?

Not for anything on this page: elements, temperament, Graha Maitri and Bhakoot read the same both ways. Some other kootas of Guna Milan, such as Varna and Vashya, do look at who is the bride and who is the groom.
